<img src="images/main_logo.png" class="centered-image">

## Network Graph

The **real** peer-to-peer topology of the network around GB7CAM. Every few hours
each of GB7CAM's peers is asked for its own ROUTES table (its direct neighbours),
and those are drawn here as the true edges between stations: who actually links
to whom. This is very different from a plain nodes table, which only records
which neighbour each destination was *learned through* and collapses into a star.

Larger dots are better-connected hubs; highlighted dots are GB7CAM's direct
peers. **Green** edges are RF links, **blue** are internet (AXIP). By default the
view shows the connected backbone; switch to *Show all* to include every
single-link leaf node as well.

<style>
.g-controls { font-family:sans-serif; display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; margin:10px 0; }
.g-controls input[type=search]{ padding:6px; width:220px; }
.g-btn { padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid #cfd8e3; border-radius:14px; background:#f2f6fb; color:#1f5b8f; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.88em; }
.g-btn.active { background:#1f77b4; border-color:#1f77b4; color:#fff; }
.g-counts { font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.85em; color:#666; }
.g-legend { font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.82em; color:#555; display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:4px 0 10px; }
.g-legend span::before { content:""; display:inline-block; width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; margin-right:5px; vertical-align:-1px; }
.dot-cam::before{ background:#ff6b6b; } .dot-peer::before{ background:#4dabf7; } .dot-leaf::before{ background:#adb5bd; }
.line-rf::before{ background:#2ca02c; border-radius:2px !important; width:16px !important; height:3px !important; }
.line-ip::before{ background:#748ffc; border-radius:2px !important; width:16px !important; height:3px !important; }
</style>

<div class="g-controls">
  <input id="filter" type="search" placeholder="Filter node (e.g. GB7BDH)">
  <span><button class="g-btn active" id="btn-backbone">Backbone</button><button class="g-btn" id="btn-all">Show all</button></span>
  <span>Window:
    <button class="g-btn active" data-days="3">3 days</button>
    <button class="g-btn" data-days="7">7 days</button>
    <button class="g-btn" data-days="14">14 days</button>
  </span>
  <span class="g-counts" id="counts">loading…</span>
</div>

<div class="g-legend">
  <span class="dot-cam">GB7CAM</span>
  <span class="dot-peer">Direct peer</span>
  <span class="dot-leaf">Other node</span>
  <span class="line-rf">RF link</span>
  <span class="line-ip">Internet (AXIP)</span>
</div>

<div id="network" style="height:72vh; border:1px solid #ddd; background:#ffffff;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>
<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph/edges";
let allData = null, network = null, visNodes = null, visEdges = null;
let windowDays = 3, backboneOnly = true;

function isCam(id){ return id.startsWith("GB7CAM"); }
function nodeColor(n){ if (isCam(n.id)) return "#ff6b6b"; if (n.peer) return "#4dabf7"; return "#adb5bd"; }
function nodeSize(n){ return Math.max(9, Math.min(34, 9 + n.degree * 2.5)); }
function edgeColor(e){ if (e.rf) return "#2ca02c"; if (e.quality === 0) return "#e03131"; return "#748ffc"; }
function edgeWidth(q){ return Math.max(1, Math.min(6, (q || 50) / 50)); }

// Backbone = GB7CAM, direct peers, and anything with more than one link.
// That drops the single-link leaf nodes hanging off one peer, leaving the
// interconnected core.
function keepSet(nodes){
  if (!backboneOnly) return new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));
  return new Set(nodes.filter(n => n.peer || isCam(n.id) || n.degree >= 2).map(n => n.id));
}

function render(data){
  allData = data;
  const keep = keepSet(data.nodes);

  visNodes = new vis.DataSet(data.nodes.filter(n => keep.has(n.id)).map(n => ({
    id: n.id,
    label: n.id,
    color: { background: nodeColor(n), border: "#33475b" },
    size: nodeSize(n),
    shape: "dot",
    title: `${n.id} — ${n.degree} link${n.degree === 1 ? "" : "s"}${n.peer ? " (direct peer)" : ""}`,
    font: { size: (isCam(n.id) || n.peer) ? 15 : 10, color: "#222" }
  })));

  visEdges = new vis.DataSet(data.edges.filter(e => keep.has(e.from) && keep.has(e.to)).map((e, i) => ({
    id: i,
    from: e.from,
    to: e.to,
    color: { color: edgeColor(e), highlight: "#000", opacity: 0.7 },
    width: edgeWidth(e.quality),
    title: `${e.from} — ${e.to} · quality ${e.quality}${e.rf ? " · RF" : ""} · seen ${e.seen}×`
  })));

  network = new vis.Network(document.getElementById("network"),
    { nodes: visNodes, edges: visEdges },
    {
      physics: {
        stabilization: { iterations: 200 },
        barnesHut: { gravitationalConstant: -14000, springLength: 130, springConstant: 0.03, avoidOverlap: 0.3 }
      },
      nodes: { shape: "dot" },
      edges: { smooth: { type: "dynamic" } },
      interaction: { hover: true, tooltipDelay: 120 }
    });

  updateCounts();
  applyFilter();
}

function updateCounts(){
  document.getElementById("counts").textContent =
    `${visNodes.length} nodes · ${visEdges.length} links · ${allData.peer_count} peers · last ${allData.window_days} days`;
}

/* filter, with +1 neighbour hop, applied to the single view (batched updates) */
function applyFilter(){
  if (!visNodes) return;
  const q = document.getElementById("filter").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!q){
    visNodes.update(visNodes.map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: false })));
    visEdges.update(visEdges.map(e => ({ id: e.id, hidden: false })));
    return;
  }
  const seed = new Set();
  visNodes.forEach(n => { if (n.id.includes(q)) seed.add(n.id); });
  const keep = new Set(seed);
  visEdges.forEach(e => { if (seed.has(e.from) || seed.has(e.to)) { keep.add(e.from); keep.add(e.to); } });
  visNodes.update(visNodes.map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: !keep.has(n.id) })));
  visEdges.update(visEdges.map(e => ({ id: e.id, hidden: !(keep.has(e.from) && keep.has(e.to)) })));
}

function debounce(fn, ms){ let t; return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms); }; }

function load(){
  document.getElementById("counts").textContent = "loading…";
  fetch(`${API}?days=${windowDays}`).then(r => r.json()).then(render)
    .catch(() => { document.getElementById("counts").textContent = "graph unavailable"; });
}

/* controls */
document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", debounce(applyFilter, 150));
document.getElementById("btn-backbone").addEventListener("click", () => {
  backboneOnly = true;
  document.getElementById("btn-backbone").classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById("btn-all").classList.remove("active");
  render(allData);
});
document.getElementById("btn-all").addEventListener("click", () => {
  backboneOnly = false;
  document.getElementById("btn-all").classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById("btn-backbone").classList.remove("active");
  render(allData);
});
document.querySelectorAll(".g-btn[data-days]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".g-btn[data-days]").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
  b.classList.add("active");
  windowDays = parseInt(b.dataset.days, 10);
  load();
}));

load();
</script>
